title: uniQure
summary: Dutch gene-therapy company focused on central-nervous-system and liver diseases.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

uniQure develops AAV gene therapies for Huntington's disease, haemophilia and other rare conditions, and has an approved therapy in Europe. It operates its own manufacturing and has partnered programmes with larger companies. Clinical data and financing dominate the story.

Technology Exposure

  • AAV gene therapy
  • Huntington's and haemophilia programmes
  • Gene-therapy manufacturing

What To Watch

  • Clinical data
  • Regulatory path
  • Cash runway

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
